# Coco Tran

> A luxury travel publication by Coco Tran — luxury travel advisor (Coco Tran Travel) and film photographer (Coco Tran Studio). First-hand hotel, camp and lodge reviews, destination guides, day-by-day routes and dispatches, all from stays and trips Coco Tran actually took and photographed.

Everything here is written from first-hand experience. Properties are reviewed room by room after a real stay; guides are organised by neighbourhood the way the city actually works; routes are itineraries built for real clients. Some pieces are members-only; the opening section of each is public.

## Formats

- [The Verdict (Property reviews)](https://cocotran.com/property/): full hotel, camp and lodge reviews, plus side-by-side comparisons.
- [The Primer and The Rolodex (Guides)](https://cocotran.com/guide/): what to know before you book, and where to stay, eat and go by neighbourhood.
- [The Route and The Dossier (Briefs)](https://cocotran.com/brief/): day-by-day itineraries and destination planning files.
- [The Shortlist](https://cocotran.com/shortlist/): curated picks — restaurants, cafés, beaches, hotels.
- [The Dispatch](https://cocotran.com/dispatch/): postcards and field notes written days after a stay.
